fact: Senegal's 2026 Digital Ministry budget was set at CFA 81.06bn, of which CFA 58.2bn (about 60%) goes to investment in digital and telecom projects; the document gives no date for the event, so its published date 2026-01 is used.
Budget tables: the budget for 2026 gives 31,915,316,171 XOF to 25 digital line(s). Dated by the budget document.
The Assembly finance committee adopted a 2025 budget of CFA 31.1bn for the digital sector of the Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital on 17 December 2024.
The digital sector's budget rose 93.2% from CFA 16.1bn in 2024 to CFA 31.1bn in 2025.

The 2024 finance law (Loi 2023-18 of 15 December 2023) gave the digital economy sector of the Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital CFA 16.1bn, within a CFA 42.7bn ministry envelope.
The digital economy sector's budget rose 93.2% from CFA 16.1bn in 2024 to CFA 31.1bn in 2025, per committee reporting of 17 December 2024.
